name: Lofoten, Svolvær, Tjeldbergtinden, Øststarten
description: Nice start between Kabelvåg and Svolvær. A road on the east side takes you to the foot of the mountain, then you must walk 5-800 meters up the hillside. Call the tower at Svolvær lufthavn before takeoff: 75 54 16 37 (updated 17.08.2023)
